title: 第3章 回到家族与支持第4章 抵达橡木城
slug: 穿越自带炼妖壶桀桀顷刻炼化
content_zh:
宽阔的国王大道上，罗恩已经接受完册封，他现在已经是一名正式的男爵了。
走在返回家族的路上，罗恩这次不是孤身一人了，而是带了一整个车队。
这支车队由数十辆马车组成，每辆马车上都堆满了各式各样的铁器。
长矛、铁剑，弓箭以及十副铠甲，还有各种实用的农具。
这些都是罗恩特意从王都采购的珍贵物资。
王都的金属价格是全国最低的，如果等到抵达开拓地后再购买金属材料，恐怕就要花费数倍于现在的价钱了。
对于开拓贵族，王都中有诸多针对此的贷款，皆由王都的贵族及大商团所提供，早已形成一套完备的产业链。
而偿还的代价就是领地开拓成功之后的各种商铺地址，售卖权，商队，关税之类的。
对于前往开拓地，除了那些渴望发财的冒险者和佣兵外。
还有一部分人也会选择加入这个行列，低等贵族的次子、私生子或者落魄的骑士们。
对他们来说，追随某位成功的开拓领主或许是改变阶级的唯一机会。
一旦领主成功开拓，会分封数位有产骑士，这些新晋骑士便能够在骑士领的土地上开垦农田、建造庄园。
建立起自己的家族然后世代效忠领主。
这算是一条较好的出路了，原身如果不回归家族的话，大概从骑士团出来后也会走这样一条路。
此次册封，每位贵族都获得了大公给予的精灵赏赐。
罗恩获得的是一个小麦精灵虫和蒲公英精灵虫。
其中蒲公英精灵虫是魔药精灵。以此来确保贵族有能力供养骑士修炼。
罗恩在王都也申请了贷款，2000金币，这是他能撸到的最大额度的贷款了。
这个世界的货币有铜币银币和金币。兑换比例都是1:100。
大多数人对于金币还有一个称呼金龙。

一般一个黑面包的售价也就是两个铜币。一个平民一年也赚不到一个金龙。
罗恩花了1500枚金龙在王都的精灵虫交易市场买了两个精灵虫。
还好有子爵夫人赞助的500枚金龙，不然罗恩还真不敢买两个精灵虫。
魔药精灵虫太贵了，一般是农业精灵虫的三倍起。特别稀有的更是能达到10倍以上。
关键是魔药精灵虫基本不会出现在市场上，一出现就被各大贵族扫走。
罗恩这次购买的一个是番薯精灵虫，一个是黑麦精灵虫。
这些都是开拓领主最喜欢的精灵虫，毕竟开拓前期最重要的就是粮食了。
将精灵虫都契约后，罗恩越看越喜欢，精灵虫简直是这个世界的宠儿，让每个生物都不忍心伤害它。
精灵虫的寿命一般是15~20年。小精灵的寿命是50年，大精灵的寿命是150年。元素精灵的寿命是500年，自然精灵的寿命是1000年。
一个农业精灵虫的覆盖范围是100亩，而魔药精灵虫则只有5亩。
把贷款来的钱花得干干净净。
罗恩就踏上了返乡的旅程，准备回家族，要人要钱。
哈特·小扁豆，一名中阶骑士扈从，已经快30岁了，是一名落魄贵族骑士，这是罗恩在王都里招揽的骑士。
迪克·窗帘，这是一名富商之子，他的父亲为罗恩捐献了200个金龙，罗恩才收下他当做扈从，斗气修炼也只是入门。
车队里随行的还有各种工匠。铁匠，木匠，泥瓦匠，石匠。这些都是王国战争中被俘虏的奴隶。
对于这些奴隶而言，被开拓领主买走虽然危险了点，但也不算特别糟糕，因为开拓领主更需要他们。
一般工作几年就会被领主赐予自由民的身份。
哈特·小扁豆从队伍中走出来，到罗恩身边说道：
“大人。再过前面的那个镇子就到西兰花领了，咱们报信的人回来说，男爵大人已经准备好迎接了。”
content_en:
On the broad King's Road, Ron has received the canonization, and he is now an official baron.
On the way back to his family, Ron was not alone this time, but with a whole convoy.
This convoy consisted of dozens of carriages, each carriage piled with various iron tools.
Spears, iron swords, bows and arrows, ten pairs of armor, and various practical farming tools.
These are precious materials that Ron specially purchased from the royal capital.
The price of metal in the royal capital is the lowest in the country. If you wait until you arrive in the pioneering land to buy metal materials, you will probably spend several times the current price.
For the development of nobles, there are many loans in the royal capital, all provided by the nobles and large business groups in the royal capital, and a complete industrial chain has already been formed.
The price of repayment is various store addresses, sales rights, caravans, tariffs, etc. after the territory is successfully developed.
Except for those adventurers and mercenaries who are eager to make a fortune, there are no other options for going to the pioneer land.
There are also some people who will choose to join this ranks, such as the second sons of lower nobles, illegitimate sons or down-and-out knights.
For them, following a successful pioneer lord may be their only chance to change class.
Once the lord successfully develops, he will enfeoff several wealthy knights, and these new knights will be able to cultivate farmland and build manors on the land of the knight's territory.
Build your own family and serve your lord for generations.
This is a better way out. If the original person had not returned to the family, he would probably have taken this path after leaving the Knights.
During this canonization, each noble received an elf reward from the Grand Duke.
What Ron got was a wheat fairy bug and a dandelion fairy bug.
Among them, the dandelion fairy bug is the potion fairy. This is to ensure that the nobles have the ability to support the knights' training.
Ron also applied for a loan in the royal capital, for 2,000 gold coins, which was the largest loan he could get.
The currencies of this world include copper coins, silver coins and gold coins. The exchange ratio is 1:100.
Most people also have another name for gold coins: golden dragon.
Generally, the price of a piece of black bread is two copper coins. A commoner cannot earn a gold dragon in a year.
Ron spent 1,500 gold dragons to buy two elf bugs at the elf bug trading market in the royal capital.
Fortunately, there were 500 golden dragons sponsored by the Viscountess, otherwise Ron would not have dared to buy two elf bugs.
Magic elf bugs are too expensive, generally starting at three times the price of agricultural elf bugs. Especially rare ones can reach more than 10 times.
The key is that magic potion elf bugs will rarely appear on the market, and will be swept away by the major nobles as soon as they appear.
The one Ron bought this time was a sweet potato fairy bug and the other was a rye fairy bug.
These are the favorite elf bugs of the pioneer lords. After all, the most important thing in the early stages of pioneering is food.
After contracting all the elf bugs, Ron liked them more and more. The elf bugs were simply the darlings of this world, and no creature could bear to harm them.
The lifespan of fairy bugs is generally 15 to 20 years. The lifespan of a small elf is 50 years, and the lifespan of a big elf is 150 years. The lifespan of elemental spirits is 500 years, and the lifespan of natural spirits is 1,000 years.
The coverage area of ​​an agricultural elf bug is 100 acres, while the coverage area of ​​a magic elf bug is only 5 acres.
Spend the loan money cleanly.
Ron embarked on a journey back home, preparing to return to his family and ask for people and money.
Hart Lentil, a mid-level knight's retinue, is almost 30 years old and a down-and-out noble knight. This is the knight recruited by Ron in the royal capital.
Dick Curtain was the son of a wealthy businessman. His father donated 200 golden dragons to Ron, so Ron accepted him as a follower. Dou Qi cultivation was just an introduction.
The convoy was accompanied by various craftsmen. Blacksmith, carpenter, mason, mason. These were slaves captured during the kingdom's wars.For these slaves, although it is a bit dangerous to be bought by the pioneer lord, it is not particularly bad, because the pioneer lord needs them more.
Generally, after working for a few years, the lord will grant the status of a free citizen.
Hart Lentil walked out of the team, came to Ron's side and said:
"My Lord. The town ahead is Broccoli Ling. Our messenger came back and said that the Baron is ready to receive you."
